short.title: Intel D270: what's behind 480GB?
short.description: Intel's own D270 has 160GB; partner versions can offer up to 480GB. These are different configurations, with independent production benchmarks still outstanding. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: Intel's D270 inference GPU is rated at 350 watts, with up to 1.5 terabytes per second memory bandwidth. Intel's own card has 160 gigabytes of memory. Partners may offer versions with up to 480 gigabytes. Performance numbers need independent workload tests. Read today's Sapiver Forge Daily Brief.
